mechanism: Erythromycin may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing topiramate levels, while topiramate can induce CYP3A4 creating variable interactions; both drugs carry CNS depressant properties.
action: Monitor for increased topiramate adverse effects (cognitive impairment, ataxia, sedation); consider alternative macrolide if CNS effects emerge; no dose adjustment typically required but clinical monitoring is warranted.
